# TrulyPlaced

> TrulyPlaced helps people land interviews in two ways. TrulyPlaced Autopilot (app.trulyplaced.com) is an app that finds US jobs that fit your resume, tailors your resume and cover letter to each one, and fills in and sends the application: free for 25 applications, then $19.99 a month for up to 1,200 a month, cancel any time. For people who want it done for them, TrulyPlaced also offers a done-for-you service where a career specialist applies for you, for roles in the US, UK, Canada and Australia.

## Service

- [Home](https://trulyplaced.com/): how it works, what a sprint looks like, members' offers, pricing and FAQ
- Done-for-you pricing: paid once for a volume of applications (250, 500 or 1,000) at $299, $449 or $699; each price includes a one-time $100 onboarding fee
- [Cancellation & Refund Policy](https://trulyplaced.com/refunds.html): unused applications are refunded pro-rata
- [About](https://trulyplaced.com/about.html): who TrulyPlaced is, what it does, the company behind it
- [Contact](https://trulyplaced.com/contact.html): hello@trulyplaced.com, WhatsApp, business details

## The app

- [TrulyPlaced Autopilot](https://app.trulyplaced.com): finds US jobs that fit your resume (matches in about 20 seconds), tailors your resume and cover letter for each one, and sends the applications on employers' own pages (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable). Autopilot sends up to 25 a day on its own, or you review each first. Answers are remembered, verification codes from employers are entered automatically, and interview emails get Join, Schedule and Add to calendar. Free for 25 applications; Pro is $19.99 a month for up to 1,200 applications; cancel any time.

## Free tools

- [Resume X-Ray (free ATS resume checker)](https://trulyplaced.com/ats-check.html): see what an applicant tracking system extracts from your resume and what it drops, get every bullet graded, and check your match against a job. Runs in the browser; the resume never leaves the device.
